in_marathi.name: Gangadhara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Ganga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangadhara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gangadhara refers to the deity who holds the Ganga river in his matted hair. According to Hindu mythology, this deity is an avatar of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bestow blessings of purity, protection, and salvation.

in_bengali.name: Gangadhara

According to Hindu mythology, this deity is an avatar of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bestow blessings of purity, protection, and salvation.
